test_title: PYST 43: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The dance performance __was more beautifuler__ than I expected.
solution:
The correct answer is '**was more beautiful**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** answer according to the **Degree rules** of the English language is '**was more beautiful**'.
 
• The word '**beautifuler**' does not exist in the English language.
 
• According to the Degree rule__, '***An adjective in comparative degree is usually followed by 'than'***.
 
• The forms of degree for the adjective beautiful will be as follows:
 
 
• **Positive Degree**- Beautiful
 
• **Comparative Degree**- More beautiful
 
• **Superlative Degree**- Most beautiful.
 
 
 
• Hence, considering the above-mentioned points, the correct answer is '**was more beautiful**'.
